title: Anthropic launches Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5 with 30-day safety retention
summary: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5 as the first publicly available Mythos-class model on $10/$50 per million input/output tokens, with Claude Mythos 5 reserved for Project Glasswing cyber partners and trusted biology researchers; Anthropic also announced a 30-day data retention policy for both models, even for zero-retention enterprise customers.

title: Apple debuts third-generation Apple Foundation Models built with Google, on-device and Private Cloud Compute
summary: At WWDC 2026, Apple introduced five third-generation Apple Foundation Models custom-built with Google, spanning two on-device variants (3B dense AFM 3 Core and 20B sparse AFM 3 Core Advanced activating 1–4B params) and three Private Cloud Compute server models (AFM 3 Cloud, ADM 3 Cloud Image, AFM 3 Cloud Pro) that power Siri AI, Image Playground, expressive voices, and agentic tool use across iOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS 27, and visionOS 27.

title: Anthropic ships Claude support in Apple's Foundation Models framework via Swift package
summary: Anthropic released a new Swift package that lets Apple developers hand off from Apple's on-device Foundation Models framework to Claude for multi-step reasoning, code generation, web search, and code execution, with streaming, tool calls, and structured responses flowing back into SwiftUI views on iOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS 27, visionOS 27, and watchOS 27.

title: OpenAI rolls out Dreaming v3 memory architecture for ChatGPT, freeing up 5x compute for free users
summary: OpenAI deployed its third-generation Dreaming memory system across ChatGPT, cutting serving compute for memory on free users by roughly 5x so the same quality bar can be extended to Free and Go tiers, while Plus and Pro users gain expanded memory capacity with a reviewable Memory Summary page that lets them add, update, or pin context for future conversations.

title: xAI ships Grok Imagine 1.5 Preview image-to-video at 720p with native audio on the API
summary: xAI released grok-imagine-video-1.5-preview, an image-to-video model that animates a still frame at up to 720p with prompt-controlled camera, pacing, and sound design, chains multiple shots into longer consistent scenes, and is priced at $0.08 per second across us-east-1, us-west-2, and eu-west-1.

title: xAI's Grok Voice becomes the default engine for 2.5M+ agents on Vapi
summary: xAI partnered with Vapi to make Grok Voice the default engine for Vapi's 12 core voices across more than 2.5 million voice agents; Vapi's blind head-to-head arena ranked Grok Voice #1 and Grok Speech-to-Text and Text-to-Speech are now selectable in the Vapi dashboard alongside custom voice cloning through the Grok Voice API.

title: Alibaba launches Qwen3.7-Plus multimodal agent model at one-sixth the price of Qwen3.7-Max
summary: Alibaba released Qwen3.7-Plus on the Bailian platform, adding vision, video understanding, deep reasoning, self-programming, tool invocation, verification and testing, and autonomous iteration over the text-only Qwen3.7-Max; pricing lands at $0.40 per million input tokens and $1.60 per million output tokens, with the model ranked #5 globally on Vision Arena.

title: Alibaba opens Qwen app to external agents and skills, escalating China's AI agent war
summary: Alibaba announced that the consumer Qwen app will open its ecosystem to third-party agents and skills, joining Tencent's push to weave agentic AI into WeChat and positioning Qwen against Doubao, Kimi, and Yuanbao as the model and platform layer for an agent-driven super-app economy in China.

title: Microsoft announces Work IQ APIs for Microsoft 365 Copilot, generally available June 16
summary: Microsoft will GA the Work IQ APIs on June 16, 2026, giving agents a consumption-priced surface to reason over email, calendar, meetings, chats, files, people, and collaboration patterns across Microsoft 365; a new cost-management dashboard in the Microsoft 365 admin center will let IT admins set Copilot Credit limits per tenant, group, or user.

title: NVIDIA launches Cosmos 3, the first fully open omnimodel for physical AI
summary: Unveiled at GTC Taipei, NVIDIA's Cosmos 3 is the first fully open mixture-of-transformers omnimodel that reasons and generates across text, images, video, ambient sound, and action for robotics and AV training; Super and Nano variants are available now on build.nvidia.com and Hugging Face under the OpenMDW 1.1 license, with Cosmos Coalition partners including Black Forest Labs, Runway, and Skild AI.

title: NVIDIA Alpamayo 2 Super brings 32B-parameter reasoning VLA to level-4 robotaxi development
summary: NVIDIA introduced Alpamayo 2 Super, a 32B open reasoning vision-language-action model that scales 3x over the 10B Alpamayo family and adds full-surround perception plus Meta-Actions for yielding, lane changes, and stops; inference code and weights land on GitHub and Hugging Face this summer, alongside AlpaGym, OmniDreams, and Omniverse NuRec.

title: NVIDIA releases Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B MoE for long-running agents with Perplexity, Palantir, and ServiceNow
summary: Announced at GTC Taipei, Nemotron 3 Ultra is a 550B MoE with 55B active parameters and hybrid Mamba-Transformer layers that delivers up to 5x faster inference and 30% lower cost-to-completion on agentic benchmarks; CrowdStrike and Palantir are early adopters, and the model is open under the Nemotron Coalition.

title: Runway joins NVIDIA's Cosmos Coalition to co-develop open world models for physical AI
summary: Runway announced it is a founding member of the NVIDIA-led Cosmos Coalition alongside Black Forest Labs, Generalist, LTX, Skild AI, and Agile Robots; the first joint project will be a base world model codeveloped by Runway and NVIDIA, with shared infrastructure and mutual contribution across the open ecosystem.

title: Hugging Face hands OpenEnv agentic RL standard to a PyTorch-led community committee
summary: Hugging Face transferred stewardship of OpenEnv, its open standard for agentic reinforcement-learning environments, to a new community committee that includes Meta-PyTorch, Reflection, Unsloth, Modal, Prime Intellect, NVIDIA, Mercor, Fleet AI, and Hugging Face itself; OpenEnv is hosted at huggingface/OpenEnv and positions itself as the interop layer between training libraries and shared agentic harnesses.

title: Hugging Face rebuilds the hf CLI around coding agents like Claude Code and Codex
summary: Hugging Face released an agent-aware build of the hf CLI that detects Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, Pi, and a universal AI_AGENT env var, switches output to an unformatted dense mode, and tags each Hub request with an agent-prefixed user-agent; on multi-step tasks the agent-driven baseline uses up to 6x fewer tokens than hand-rolled curl or the Python SDK.

title: MiniMax launches M3, the first open-weight model with 1M context, multimodality, and frontier coding
summary: MiniMax's M3 ships with the new MiniMax Sparse Attention (MSA) architecture to support a 1M-token context window, native image and video input, and computer use; it scores 59.0% on SWE-Bench Pro and 70.06% on OSWorld-Verified, with a $20/month Token Plan, discounted launch API pricing, and open weights due within 10 days.

title: Moonshot AI launches Kimi Work, a desktop agent that runs 300 specialized agents in parallel
summary: Moonshot AI released Kimi Work, a Windows and macOS desktop agent that orchestrates up to 300 specialized sub-agents over the Agent Swarm architecture introduced with Kimi K2.6; the product combines local folder access, autonomous web navigation, background Python execution, scheduled tasks, and a memory layer that retains preferences across sessions.

title: Mistral unifies Le Chat into Vibe, a single long-running agent for work and code
summary: Mistral folded Le Chat and the Vibe CLI into one Vibe agent on a single license, adding Work mode for long-horizon research and analysis, Code mode for remote coding agents on the web, and a new VS Code extension; sessions can run in parallel, persist while the user's machine is off, and be triggered from third-party apps like Slack.

title: Adobe CX Enterprise Coworker hits GA as an agentic central intelligence layer for customer experience
summary: Adobe made CX Enterprise Coworker generally available as an outcomes-based agentic AI system that synthesizes Adobe and third-party data, coordinates AI agents across analytics, content, and journey orchestration, and ships with built-in MCP and Agent2Agent interoperability; Adobe Experience Platform now powers more than 1 trillion experiences annually as the contextual layer underneath.

title: Perplexity unveils hybrid local-server inference orchestrator at Computex, shipping in July
summary: Perplexity demonstrated the first hybrid local-server inference orchestrator alongside Intel at Computex 2026; a compact on-device router classifies each subtask by data sensitivity and compute need, then dispatches work to the local machine or to a frontier cloud model, with the model-agnostic harness confirmed to run on Intel Core Ultra Series 3 and NVIDIA RTX Spark silicon.

title: Perplexity ships Search as Code, an Agentic Search SDK that lets models assemble retrieval pipelines
summary: Perplexity introduced Search as Code (SaC), a new search architecture that exposes the building blocks of its search stack as SDK primitives so any model can assemble a retrieval pipeline on demand inside a secure sandbox; SaC is live today in Perplexity Computer and the Agent API, advancing the cost-performance frontier on knowledge-intensive agent benchmarks.

title: Zhipu launches GLM-5.1 with 8-hour autonomous work mode and 10% price hike
summary: Zhipu released GLM-5.1 with a new '8-hour work mode' that lets the model independently plan, execute, test, and self-repair across a single task, becoming the first domestic model to top Opus 4.6 on SWE-bench Pro; pricing rose 10%, reaching parity with Anthropic in coding scenarios as the company pivots from price competition to long-duration agent execution.

title: ByteDance confirms Doubao Pro Edition will charge 68 to 500 yuan per month starting late June
summary: ByteDance confirmed its Doubao AI assistant will launch a paid Pro Edition in late June with tiers at 68, 200, and 500 yuan per month, covering software development, data analysis, design, workflow automation, and scientific research; basic chatbot functions will remain free as Doubao prepares to integrate e-commerce into Q3 ahead of the Volcano Engine Force Conference.

title: Meta's Muse Spark AI replaces Llama 4 across Ray-Ban and Oakley smart glasses
summary: Meta Superintelligence Labs extended its Muse Spark model to all Ray-Ban and Oakley smart glasses except Meta Ray-Ban Display; Muse Spark matches Llama 4 Maverick performance at 10x lower compute, is closed-source, and Meta has delayed the public API multiple times since April while targeting a release within June.
